wave: P1 Wave B (wave 1: generators A+B+C only)
method: Hypothesis-level cross-shard dedup: each idea compared on core_hypothesis content (mechanism + falsifiable claim), not title strings. Near-duplicates grouped; template/permutation families (SAM+X, LoRA+X, loss+X, hidden-variable-confound, shortcut-ablation, reweighting, statistical-noise, mask-forensics) flagged; per group one or two primaries kept and the rest marked kill_or_merge with explicit merge targets. High-value anomalies protected. NO novelty verification performed; all prior-art-risk remarks are unverified judge hypotheses. No citations invented. Canonical state untouched.

duplicate_groups.theme: Per-case score distributions on hard/shifted settings are bimodal, so mean metrics track mixture weight and misrank methods.
Zero-shot claims inflated by pretraining-set overlap; overlap/similarity-stratified re-evaluation deflates them.
Benchmark splits are non-iid (source/session/video/time/near-dup galleries); honest disjoint re-splitting reduces scores and reranks.
Evaluating against a single hard label where ground truth is a distribution/set misstates scores and rankings; distribution-matching evaluation reranks and reframes superhuman claims.
At foundation scale, cheap deterministic feature-space signals match or beat sampling-based and confidence-based uncertainty for error detection.
Model uncertainty maps (entropy/ensemble/dropout/learned-aleatoric) do not spatially match true inter-rater disagreement.
The training objective, not data or architecture, sets systematic mask-geometry biases (extent asymmetry, topology, morphology fingerprints).
Hidden annotation/training-pipeline variables (loss, tool, institution) are decodable from mask geometry alone and are inherited by models.
Flat single-label output spaces are the dominant error source for see-through media; two-layer (front/rear or medium/background) outputs reclassify much error.
Binary-mask leaderboards on soft-boundary classes measure annotator-threshold agreement, not perception.
Training pressure with unique ground truth (task PEFT, synthetic data, distillation) collapses hypothesis diversity invisibly to target metrics.
Pre-adaptation feature-similarity measurements predict PEFT gain/crossover before training.
Much claimed domain adaptation is low-order photometric re-centering (input stem, biases, norms) rather than feature re-learning.
Under shift, mask ranking/selection degrades faster than mask generation; oracle protocols hide it and selection-only fixes harvest it.
The click-to-mask map has structured non-smoothness (failure sets, aliasing, basins); attacks and transfer failures are derivative.
Unreported evaluation-stack factors (preprocessing, libraries, resolution, TTA, norm adaptation, parsers) contribute variance comparable to claimed gains.
Model rankings/calibration unstable under prompt-template and class-wording substitution.
Published deltas are within resampling/seed/draw noise; benchmarks underpowered for frontier effect sizes.
Aggregate leaderboards encode arbitrary composition weights; defensible reweightings change rankings.
Contamination extends beyond pixel duplicates (semantic scenes, generative derivatives, generator templates); dedup pipelines undercount it.
Test-informed development (leaderboard queries, checkpoint selection) inflates canonical test scores measurably.
VLM benchmark answers substantially image-independent; consistency/blind ablations deflate grounding claims.
Benchmark items solvable from statistical priors (language co-occurrence, salience, count modes) without perception; prior-decorrelated item sets rerank.
Multi-input (multi-image/video) benchmarks solvable from one input due to construction economics.
Learned judges/metrics favor outputs stylistically close to their own training lineage, corrupting comparisons.
Area-under-curve metrics misrank methods at deployment-relevant operating points and confound accuracy.
Performance/robustness gaps attributed to representations actually live in the readout head/decoder (or provably do not, per B-031's counter-prediction).
Nominal marginal conformal coverage hides conditional/structure-level/practical failure.
Mature benchmarks approach label-error/annotator-disagreement floors; remaining leaderboard spread is noise-fitting.
SA-1B professional-photography statistics leave position/viewpoint priors detectable by controlled placement.
SAM's predicted-IoU head is a style critic (shared premise family flagged by generator A itself); derivative applications stand or fall with the root claim.
Transparent-object models make no use of refraction physics; render-space ablations prove it.
Hard-domain failures cluster by boundary-evidence type, not application domain.

anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-044: Representational blind spot claim (relationally-defined regions unreachable by prompt-as-locator interfaces regardless of PEFT) - a capability-boundary hypothesis, not a permutation.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-063: Guideline archaeology: foundation models memorize annotation POLICY, recoverable from output conventions - unusual forensic epistemics.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-065: SA-1B grid-generation periodic fingerprint inside SAM's priors - exotic, cheap to test, high surprise value either way.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-079: Modal/amodal mode instability governed lawfully by prompt geometry - reframes SAM outputs as unreliable for either ground-truth type.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-087: Catastrophic remembering: adaptation moves a model BACKWARD along its own training history, resurrecting suppressed biases - novel direction-of-forgetting framing.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-016: Contrarian ceiling claim: humans under matched static conditions drop toward model accuracy on glass - attacks the premise that a human-model gap exists.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-029: Ontological (not statistical) scaling asymptote for transparency/participating media - a falsifiable anti-scaling claim.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-030: Mass-noun vs count-noun linguistic penalty in text-prompted segmentation - unusual cross-linguistic mechanism for a vision failure.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-054: Representation-ambiguity matching law (soft maps for boundary ambiguity, mask sets for topological ambiguity) - a design law, testable by double dissociation.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-069: Predict the derivative (spread-rate field) instead of the state (extent mask) - claims the derivative is more annotator-stable and decision-relevant.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-071: Event-camera combustion microdynamics separating real flames from reflections - modality-specific solution to a modality-created problem.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-083: Sparse physical sensor labels beating dense human labels per unit cost for calibrated extent - inverts the annotation-value hierarchy.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-090: Ambiguity-type transfer beats domain-appearance transfer - if true, restructures how transfer sources are chosen.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-093: Human-model failure complementarity is largest on hard domains - team-headroom claim with direct measurement path.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-069: Model-assisted annotation creates dataset-level self-preference loops - contamination pathway invisible to image-level audits.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-072: Annotation-vendor ecosystems as convention-leakage channels between training data and benchmarks - leakage without any shared pixels.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-074: Winner's-curse quantification for leaderboards from submission statistics - clean statistical mechanism for SOTA inflation.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-075: Benchmark ecosystem has low effective dimensionality (one or two principal components) - meta-claim that most benchmarks are re-measurements.

caveats: This judge performed redundancy/clustering triage ONLY. No novelty is verified for any kept idea; every keep remains an unverified hypothesis pending prior-art search.
Prior-art-risk remarks in kill reasons and notes are the judge's unverified assessments (labeled HYPOTHESIS); no citations were fabricated to support them.
kill_or_merge is scientific-redundancy consolidation, not a quality verdict; merge targets identify where the content should be folded if a later Consolidator agrees.
Accepted list is for THIS wave (A+B+C) only; later generator waves and judges may change dispositions. Parent will not merge; a Consolidator writes canonical state.
